header: Seals with their scope, and a link to the register
lead: Two to twelve certificates. The link goes to the issuing body rather than to a page of your own, because that is the only thing that makes a seal checkable.
note: The note carries the validity caveat: what the certificates cover, what they do not, and until when.

certificates.title: The scope belongs in the title, not the note
Link to the register, never to yourself
